name: Noir
source:
A girl that the protagonist met by chance on the Milky Way Railroad. She has cat ears and a tail but doesn't seem to care. She doesn't have any memory and is always spacing out. Who she is is unclear, but she seems to have taken a liking to the protagonist.

[Translated from the [url=http://shiratamaco.com/]official website[/url]]
